integrity: Seven self-contained UTF-8 files with recomputable lengths and hashes. Analytical proof supplies infinite-domain claims; deterministic checker verifies finite cases only.
scientific_limitations: Equilibrium renewal ensemble, possibly not the pointwise long-time limit from synchronous deterministic reset. No interaction, entanglement, local independent clock, or hardware lower-bound claims. Established general renewal purity formulas are explicitly credited; the new scientific claims are the many-spin asymptotic coefficient and exact attainment/nonattainment at fixed mean.
title: Subextensive Rényi entropy and a sharp attainment threshold for common-clock quantum resetting
